svg.title: Website governance audit
svg.desc: Your website is already making legal promises. Every finding cites a clause and proposes a fix, for the laws where you are and where your visitors are. An animated scan checks cookies before consent, PIPEDA 4.8, GDPR Article 3(2), EU AI Act Article 50(4) and WCAG 2.5.3.
svg.text: Every finding cites a clause and proposes a fix,
for the laws where you are and where your visitors are.
